examples.en: This kind of behavior has a very bad influence.

examples.en: This scientist published new research findings.

examples.pinyin: Tā shì yí wèi yǒumíng de jiàoyù zhuānjiā.
examples.en: She is a well-known education expert.

examples.zh: 这位医学专家发表了新的研究。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi yīxué zhuānjiā fābiǎo le xīn de yánjiū.
examples.en: This medical expert published new research.

meaning: to focus one's attention; to concentrate on

examples.zh: 她专心工作，没有注意到时间。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhuānxīn gōngzuò, méiyǒu zhùyì dào shíjiān.
examples.en: She was so focused on work that she didn't notice the time.
The child is drawing with full concentration.

examples.zh: 他的想法发生了很大的转变。
examples.pinyin: Tā de xiǎngfǎ fāshēng le hěn dà de zhuǎnbiàn.
examples.en: His thoughts underwent a great transformation.

examples.pinyin: Tā de tàidu mànmàn zhuǎnbiàn le.

examples.zh: 这次经历让他有了很大的转变。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì jīnglì ràng tā yǒu le hěn dà de zhuǎnbiàn.
examples.en: This experience brought about a great change in him.

examples.zh: 公司的经营方式已经转变。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de jīngyíng fāngshì yǐjīng zhuǎnbiàn.
examples.en: The company's way of operating has already changed.

meaning: to pass on (a message); to communicate

examples.zh: 请帮我转告他这个消息。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bāng wǒ zhuǎngào tā zhège xiāoxi.
examples.en: Please help me pass this message on to him.

examples.zh: 她把老师的话转告给了同学们。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ lǎoshī de huà zhuǎngào gěi le tóngxuémen.
examples.en: She passed on the teacher's words to the classmates.

examples.zh: 我会把你的意见转告给经理。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huì bǎ nǐ de yìjiàn zhuǎngào gěi jīnglǐ.
examples.en: I will pass your opinion on to the manager.

examples.zh: 请转告他明天开会的时间改了。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng zhuǎngào tā míngtiān kāihuì de shíjiān gǎi le.
examples.en: Please tell him that tomorrow's meeting time has changed.

examples.pinyin: Tā tuō wǒ zhuǎngào nǐ yí jù huà.
examples.en: She asked me to pass a message on to you.
The workers are installing the machine.

examples.pinyin: Tā zhuāngzuò shénme dōu bù zhīdào.
examples.en: He pretended not to know anything.

examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ shū zhuāng jìn le xiāngzi lǐ.
examples.en: She packed the books into the box.
This piece of fashionable clothing is very beautiful.

examples.zh: 别装了，我知道你在骗我。
examples.pinyin: Bié zhuāng le, wǒ zhīdào nǐ zài piàn wǒ.
examples.en: Stop pretending, I know you're lying to me.

examples.pinyin: Tā yòng huā zhuāngshì le fángjiān.
examples.en: She decorated the room with flowers.

examples.zh: 这些墙上的装饰很漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē qiáng shàng de zhuāngshì hěn piàoliang.
examples.en: These decorations on the wall are very beautiful.

examples.zh: 节日到了，商店里到处都是装饰。
examples.pinyin: Jiérì dào le, shāngdiàn lǐ dàochù dōu shì zhuāngshì.
examples.en: The holiday has arrived, decorations are everywhere in the shops.

examples.zh: 他们花了很多钱装饰新家。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen huā le hěn duō qián zhuāngshì xīn jiā.
examples.en: They spent a lot of money decorating their new home.

examples.zh: 这件衣服上有很漂亮的装饰。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu shàng yǒu hěn piàoliang de zhuāngshì.
examples.en: There are very beautiful decorations on this piece of clothing.

examples.pinyin: Tā de shēntǐ zhuàngkuàng hěn hǎo.
examples.en: His physical condition is very good.

examples.zh: 公司现在的经济状况不太好。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī xiànzài de jīngjì zhuàngkuàng bú tài hǎo.
examples.en: The company's current financial situation isn't very good.

examples.zh: 医生检查了病人的健康状况。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng jiǎnchá le bìngrén de jiànkāng zhuàngkuàng.
examples.en: The doctor checked the patient's health condition.

examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù de zhuàngkuàng bú tài hǎo.
examples.en: The condition of this road isn't very good.

examples.zh: 请说明一下目前的状况。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng shuōmíng yíxià mùqián de zhuàngkuàng.
Tā jīntiān de zhuàngtài hěn hǎo.
examples.en: Her condition is very good today.

examples.zh: 他一直保持着良好的工作状态。
examples.pinyin: Tā yìzhí bǎochí zhe liánghǎo de gōngzuò zhuàngtài.
examples.en: He has always maintained a good work state.

examples.zh: 这台机器处于正常状态。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái jīqì chǔyú zhèngcháng zhuàngtài.
examples.en: This machine is in normal condition.

examples.pinyin: Tā jìnrù le jǐnzhāng de zhuàngtài.

examples.zh: 运动员比赛前调整好了状态。
examples.pinyin: Yùndòngyuán bǐsài qián tiáozhěng hǎo le zhuàngtài.
examples.en: The athlete adjusted his condition before the competition.

meaning: to pursue (a goal); to seek after; to woo

examples.zh: 他一直在追求自己的梦想。
examples.pinyin: Tā yìzhí zài zhuīqiú zìjǐ de mèngxiǎng.
examples.en: He has been pursuing his own dream.

examples.zh: 她追求完美，对自己要求很高。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhuīqiú wánměi, duì zìjǐ yāoqiú hěn gāo.
examples.en: She pursues perfection and has high demands on herself.

examples.zh: 他多年来一直在追求她。
examples.pinyin: Tā duō nián lái yìzhí zài zhuīqiú tā.
examples.en: He has been pursuing her for many years.

examples.zh: 人们都在追求幸福的生活。
examples.pinyin: Rénmen dōu zài zhuīqiú xìngfú de shēnghuó.
examples.en: People are all pursuing a happy life.

examples.zh: 公司追求的是长期发展。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī zhuīqiú de shì chángqī fāzhǎn.
examples.en: What the company pursues is long-term development.

examples.zh: 你可以咨询医生的意见。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ zīxún yīshēng de yìjiàn.
examples.en: You can consult the doctor for advice.
She went to consult a lawyer.

examples.zh: 这家公司提供法律咨询服务。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī tígōng fǎlǜ zīxún fúwù.
examples.en: This company provides legal consulting services.

examples.zh: 有问题可以随时咨询我们。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu wèntí kěyǐ suíshí zīxún wǒmen.
examples.en: If you have questions, you can consult us anytime.

examples.zh: 他打电话咨询了旅行的相关信息。
examples.pinyin: Tā dǎ diànhuà zīxún le lǚxíng de xiāngguān xìnxī.
examples.en: He called to inquire about travel-related information.

examples.pinyin: Tā zuò de zīshì hěn hǎokàn.
examples.en: Her sitting posture looks very nice.

examples.pinyin: Tā de zǒulù zīshì hěn tèbié.
examples.en: His walking posture is very distinctive.

examples.zh: 教练帮运动员改正了姿势。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoliàn bāng yùndòngyuán gǎizhèng le zīshì.
examples.en: The coach helped the athlete correct their posture.

examples.pinyin: Tā pāizhào de zīshì hěn zìrán.
examples.en: Her posture when taking photos looks very natural.

examples.zh: 她具备了参加考试的资格。
examples.pinyin: Tā jùbèi le cānjiā kǎoshì de zīgé.
examples.en: She has the qualifications to take the exam.

examples.zh: 他没有资格评价这件事。
examples.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu zīgé píngjià zhè jiàn shì.
examples.en: He doesn't have the qualification to judge this matter.

examples.zh: 申请这份工作需要一定的资格。
examples.pinyin: Shēnqǐng zhè fèn gōngzuò xūyào yídìng de zīgé.
examples.en: Applying for this job requires certain qualifications.

examples.zh: 他获得了教师资格证书。
examples.pinyin: Tā huòdé le jiàoshī zīgé zhèngshū.
examples.en: He obtained a teaching qualification certificate.

examples.zh: 她凭多年的经验和资格得到了这个职位。
examples.pinyin: Tā píng duō nián de jīngyàn hé zīgé dédào le zhège zhíwèi.
examples.en: She got this position based on years of experience and seniority.

examples.zh: 这个项目需要大量资金。
examples.en: This project requires a large amount of capital.

examples.pinyin: Tāmen shōují le bù shǎo zījīn.
examples.en: They gathered quite a lot of funds.

examples.zh: 这笔资金用于学校建设。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bǐ zījīn yòngyú xuéxiào jiànshè.
examples.en: This fund is used for school construction.

examples.pinyin: Tā shōují le hěn duō zīliào.
examples.en: She collected a lot of materials.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhèxiē zīliào zhěnglǐ hǎo.

examples.zh: 图书馆里有很多历史资料。
examples.pinyin: Túshūguǎn lǐ yǒu hěn duō lìshǐ zīliào.
examples.en: There is a lot of historical material in the library.

examples.pinyin: Tā zhèngzài chá zīliào xiě lùnwén.
examples.en: He is looking up materials to write his thesis.

examples.zh: 这份资料对我们很有帮助。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn zīliào duì wǒmen hěn yǒu bāngzhù.
examples.en: This material is very helpful to us.

examples.zh: 这个国家自然资源丰富。
examples.en: This country is rich in natural resources.

examples.zh: 我们应该合理利用资源。
examples.en: We should make reasonable use of resources.

examples.zh: 这些资源很快就用完了。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē zīyuán hěn kuài jiù yòngwán le.
examples.en: These resources were used up quickly.

examples.zh: 人才是公司最重要的资源。
examples.pinyin: Réncái shì gōngsī zuì zhòngyào de zīyuán.
examples.en: Talent is the company's most important resource.

examples.zh: 她穿着一件紫色的裙子。
examples.pinyin: Tā chuānzhe yí jiàn zǐsè de qúnzi.
examples.en: She is wearing a purple skirt.

examples.pinyin: Huāyuán lǐ de zǐ huā hěn piàoliang.
examples.en: The purple flowers in the garden are beautiful.

examples.zh: 傍晚的天空变成了紫色。
examples.pinyin: Bàngwǎn de tiānkōng biànchéng le zǐsè.
Zhè kē pútao shì zǐsè de.
Zhè bù diànyǐng yǒu Zhōngwén zìmù.
Wǒ kàn diànshì xǐhuan kāi zìmù.
examples.en: I like to turn on subtitles when watching TV.
The subtitles are a bit fast.
She learns a foreign language through subtitles.

examples.zh: 自从他来了以后，情况变好了。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng tā lái le yǐhòu, qíngkuàng biàn hǎo le.
examples.en: Since he came, the situation has improved.

examples.zh: 自从毕业以后，我们很少见面。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng bìyè yǐhòu, wǒmen hěn shǎo jiànmiàn.
examples.en: Since graduation, we rarely see each other.

examples.zh: 自从搬家以后，她一直很忙。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng bānjiā yǐhòu, tā yìzhí hěn máng.
examples.en: Since moving, she has been very busy.

examples.zh: 自从那件事以后，他变了很多。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng nà jiàn shì yǐhòu, tā biàn le hěn duō.
examples.en: Since that incident, he has changed a lot.

examples.zh: 自从学了汉语，她对中国文化更感兴趣了。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng xué le Hànyǔ, tā duì Zhōngguó wénhuà gèng gǎn xìngqù le.
examples.en: Since learning Chinese, she has become more interested in Chinese culture.

examples.pinyin: Zhè tái xǐyījī shì zìdòng de.

examples.zh: 他自动放弃了这次机会。
examples.pinyin: Tā zìdòng fàngqì le zhè cì jīhuì.
examples.en: He voluntarily gave up this opportunity.

examples.zh: 这个程序会自动保存文件。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngxù huì zìdòng bǎocún wénjiàn.

examples.zh: 灯到晚上会自动亮起来。
examples.pinyin: Dēng dào wǎnshang huì zìdòng liàng qǐlái.
examples.en: The lights automatically turn on at night.

examples.zh: 我为自己的国家感到自豪。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ wèi zìjǐ de guójiā gǎndào zìháo.
examples.en: I feel proud of my own country.

examples.zh: 她为孩子的成绩感到自豪。
examples.pinyin: Tā wèi háizi de chéngjì gǎndào zìháo.
examples.en: She feels proud of her child's achievements.

examples.zh: 他自豪地介绍了自己的家乡。
examples.pinyin: Tā zìháo de jièshào le zìjǐ de jiāxiāng.
examples.en: He proudly introduced his own hometown.

examples.zh: 这是让我们自豪的成就。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì ràng wǒmen zìháo de chéngjiù.
examples.en: This is an achievement that makes us proud.

examples.zh: 她对自己的努力感到自豪。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì zìjǐ de nǔlì gǎndào zìháo.
examples.en: She feels proud of her own effort.

meaning: conscious; self-aware; on one's own initiative

examples.zh: 她学习很自觉，不用父母提醒。
examples.pinyin: Tā xuéxí hěn zìjué, búyòng fùmǔ tíxǐng.
examples.en: She is very self-motivated in studying, no need for parents to remind her.
He consciously abides by traffic rules.

examples.zh: 孩子应该学会自觉完成作业。
examples.pinyin: Háizi yīnggāi xuéhuì zìjué wánchéng zuòyè.
examples.en: Children should learn to complete homework on their own initiative.

examples.zh: 我们要提高自己的环保自觉性。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào tígāo zìjǐ de huánbǎo zìjuéxìng.
examples.en: We should raise our own environmental awareness.

examples.zh: 他很自觉地打扫了教室。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn zìjué de dǎsǎo le jiàoshì.
examples.en: He cleaned the classroom on his own initiative.

examples.pinyin: Tā zhèyàng zuò tài zìsī le.
examples.en: It's too selfish of him to do this.

examples.zh: 她从不自私，总是先想到别人。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng bù zìsī, zǒngshì xiān xiǎngdào biérén.
examples.en: She is never selfish, always thinking of others first.

examples.zh: 自私的人很难交到真心朋友。
examples.pinyin: Zìsī de rén hěn nán jiāodào zhēnxīn péngyou.
examples.en: Selfish people find it hard to make sincere friends.

examples.pinyin: Tā zhǐgù zìjǐ, tài zìsī le.
examples.en: He only cares about himself, too selfish.

examples.zh: 他对自己的能力很自信。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì zìjǐ de nénglì hěn zìxìn.
examples.en: He is very confident in his own ability.

examples.zh: 这次成功让她更加自信了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì chénggōng ràng tā gèngjiā zìxìn le.
examples.en: This success made her even more confident.

examples.zh: 我们要培养孩子的自信心。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào péiyǎng háizi de zìxìnxīn.
Tā zìxìn de zǒushàng le jiǎngtái.
examples.en: He confidently walked up to the podium.

examples.pinyin: Háizi kěwàng gèng duō de zìyóu.

examples.zh: 这里的人民享有言论自由。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de rénmín xiǎngyǒu yánlùn zìyóu.
examples.en: The people here enjoy freedom of speech.

examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ yǒu zìyóu de shíjiān.
examples.en: I have free time on weekends.

examples.pinyin: Niǎor zài tiānkōng zìyóu de fēi.
examples.en: The bird flies freely in the sky.

examples.zh: 她自愿参加了这次活动。
examples.pinyin: Tā zìyuàn cānjiā le zhè cì huódòng.
examples.en: She voluntarily participated in this activity.

examples.zh: 这是自愿的，没有人强迫你。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì zìyuàn de, méiyǒu rén qiǎngpò nǐ.
examples.en: This is voluntary, no one is forcing you.

examples.zh: 他自愿放弃了这个机会。
examples.pinyin: Tā zìyuàn fàngqì le zhège jīhuì.
examples.en: He voluntarily gave up this opportunity.

examples.zh: 很多学生自愿去帮助老人。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō xuésheng zìyuàn qù bāngzhù lǎorén.
examples.en: Many students voluntarily go to help the elderly.
She voluntarily stayed to work overtime.

examples.zh: 每个国家都有不同的宗教。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge guójiā dōu yǒu bùtóng de zōngjiào.

examples.zh: 她对宗教历史很感兴趣。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì zōngjiào lìshǐ hěn gǎn xìngqù.
examples.en: She is very interested in religious history.

examples.zh: 这座城市有很多宗教建筑。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì yǒu hěn duō zōngjiào jiànzhù.
examples.en: This city has many religious buildings.

examples.zh: 他相信一种古老的宗教。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiāngxìn yì zhǒng gǔlǎo de zōngjiào.
examples.en: He believes in an ancient religion.

examples.zh: 我们应该尊重不同的宗教。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi zūnzhòng bùtóng de zōngjiào.
Zhè shì yì suǒ zōnghé dàxué.

examples.zh: 我们要综合考虑各种因素。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào zōnghé kǎolǜ gèzhǒng yīnsù.
examples.en: We should comprehensively consider various factors.

examples.pinyin: Tā de zōnghé nénglì hěn qiáng.
examples.en: Her comprehensive ability is very strong.

examples.zh: 这份报告综合了大家的意见。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào zōnghé le dàjiā de yìjiàn.

examples.zh: 这次考试考查综合知识。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì kǎochá zōnghé zhīshi.
Tā shì zhè jiā gōngsī de zǒngcái.
examples.en: She is the chairman of this company.
The chairman will give a speech today.

examples.zh: 他从职员一步步做到了总裁。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng zhíyuán yíbùbù zuòdào le zǒngcái.
examples.en: He worked his way up from an employee to chairman.

examples.zh: 总裁很关心员工的生活。
examples.pinyin: Zǒngcái hěn guānxīn yuángōng de shēnghuó.
examples.en: The chairman cares a lot about employees' lives.

examples.zh: 新总裁上任后做了很多改革。
examples.pinyin: Xīn zǒngcái shàngrèn hòu zuò le hěn duō gǎigé.
examples.en: After the new chairman took office, he made many reforms.
How much do these items cost altogether?

examples.zh: 我们班总共有三十个学生。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bān zǒnggòng yǒu sānshí ge xuésheng.
examples.en: Our class has thirty students in total.

examples.zh: 这次旅行总共花了五天时间。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì lǚxíng zǒnggòng huā le wǔ tiān shíjiān.
examples.en: This trip took five days in total.
How many guests came in total?

examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū zǒnggòng yǒu sānbǎi yè.
examples.en: This book has three hundred pages in total.

examples.zh: 总理今天会见了外国客人。
examples.pinyin: Zǒnglǐ jīntiān huìjiàn le wàiguó kèrén.
examples.en: The premier met with foreign guests today.
The premier gave an important speech.

examples.zh: 这位总理十分受人民爱戴。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi zǒnglǐ shífēn shòu rénmín àidài.
examples.en: This premier is deeply loved by the people.

examples.zh: 总理提出了新的经济计划。
examples.pinyin: Zǒnglǐ tíchū le xīn de jīngjì jìhuà.
examples.en: The premier proposed a new economic plan.

examples.zh: 经过努力，他总算成功了。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò nǔlì, tā zǒngsuàn chénggōng le.

examples.zh: 她总算完成了这项任务。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǒngsuàn wánchéng le zhè xiàng rènwu.

examples.zh: 这个国家选出了新总统。
examples.pinyin: Zhège guójiā xuǎnchū le xīn zǒngtǒng.
examples.en: This country elected a new president.
The president gave a speech today.
The president received the foreign representatives.

examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi zǒngtǒng hěn shòu huānyíng.
Zǒngtǒng fǎngwèn le zhè suǒ dàxué.

meaning: in a word; in short; in brief

examples.pinyin: Zǒngzhī, zhè shì yí ge hǎo jīhuì.
examples.en: In short, this is a good opportunity.

examples.zh: 总之，我们要努力完成任务。
examples.pinyin: Zǒngzhī, wǒmen yào nǔlì wánchéng rènwu.
examples.en: In short, we must work hard to complete the task.
In short, the matter has already been resolved.

examples.zh: 总之，这次活动非常成功。
examples.pinyin: Zǒngzhī, zhè cì huódòng fēicháng chénggōng.
examples.en: In short, this event was very successful.

examples.zh: 总之，我们都很满意这个结果。
examples.pinyin: Zǒngzhī, wǒmen dōu hěn mǎnyì zhège jiéguǒ.
examples.en: In short, we are all satisfied with this result.

meaning: to prevent; to stop; to block

examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá zǔzhǐ le zhè chǎng chōngtū.

examples.zh: 父母试图阻止他这样做。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ shìtú zǔzhǐ tā zhèyàng zuò.
examples.en: The parents tried to prevent him from doing this.

examples.zh: 没有什么能阻止她前进的脚步。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu shénme néng zǔzhǐ tā qiánjìn de jiǎobù.
examples.en: Nothing can stop her steps forward.

examples.zh: 他们成功阻止了事故的发生。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen chénggōng zǔzhǐ le shìgù de fāshēng.
examples.en: They successfully prevented the accident from happening.
The teacher stopped the students from fighting.

examples.zh: 这些颜色组合得很好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē yánsè zǔhé de hěn hǎokàn.

examples.zh: 他们是一个很好的组合。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen shì yí ge hěn hǎo de zǔhé.

examples.zh: 这个玩具可以组合成不同的形状。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wánjù kěyǐ zǔhé chéng bùtóng de xíngzhuàng.
examples.en: This toy can be combined into different shapes.

examples.zh: 她把不同的食材组合在一起。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ bùtóng de shícái zǔhé zài yìqǐ.
Zhè zhǒng zǔhé fāngshì hěn tèbié.
examples.en: This way of combining is very special.

examples.zh: 他深深地爱着自己的祖国。
examples.pinyin: Tā shēnshēn de àizhe zìjǐ de zǔguó.
examples.en: He deeply loves his own motherland.

examples.zh: 运动员为祖国赢得了荣誉。
examples.pinyin: Yùndòngyuán wèi zǔguó yíngdé le róngyù.
examples.en: The athlete won honor for the motherland.

examples.zh: 她离开了祖国去国外学习。
examples.pinyin: Tā líkāi le zǔguó qù guówài xuéxí.
examples.en: She left her motherland to study abroad.

examples.zh: 我们为祖国的发展感到骄傲。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen wèi zǔguó de fāzhǎn gǎndào jiāo'ào.
examples.en: We feel proud of the motherland's development.
He finally returned to his motherland.

examples.zh: 我们应该记住祖先的历史。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi jìzhù zǔxiān de lìshǐ.
examples.en: We should remember our ancestors' history.

examples.zh: 这些传统是祖先留下来的。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē chuántǒng shì zǔxiān liú xiàlái de.
examples.en: These traditions were passed down by our ancestors.

examples.zh: 每年清明节，人们会想起祖先。
examples.pinyin: Měinián Qīngmíng jié, rénmen huì xiǎngqǐ zǔxiān.
examples.en: Every year during Qingming Festival, people think of their ancestors.

examples.zh: 这个传统来自我们的祖先。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chuántǒng láizì wǒmen de zǔxiān.
examples.en: This tradition comes from our ancestors.

examples.zh: 最初，我并不喜欢这份工作。
examples.pinyin: Zuìchū, wǒ bìng bù xǐhuan zhè fèn gōngzuò.
examples.en: At first, I didn't like this job.

examples.zh: 她最初的想法后来改变了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuìchū de xiǎngfǎ hòulái gǎibiàn le.

examples.en: At first, they didn't know each other.

examples.zh: 他最初的目标是当医生。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuìchū de mùbiāo shì dāng yīshēng.
examples.en: His original goal was to become a doctor.

examples.zh: 这个罪犯已经被关起来了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zuìfàn yǐjīng bèi guān qǐlái le.
examples.en: This criminal has already been locked up.

examples.zh: 社会应该给罪犯改过自新的机会。
examples.pinyin: Shèhuì yīnggāi gěi zuìfàn gǎiguò zìxīn de jīhuì.
examples.en: Society should give criminals a chance to reform.

examples.zh: 警方正在寻找逃跑的罪犯。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngfāng zhèngzài xúnzhǎo táopǎo de zuìfàn.
examples.en: The police are searching for the fleeing criminal.

examples.zh: 这部电影讲述了一个罪犯的故事。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng jiǎngshù le yí ge zuìfàn de gùshi.
examples.en: This movie tells the story of a criminal.

examples.pinyin: Tā hē duō le, zuì le.
examples.en: He drank too much and got drunk.

examples.zh: 她从没见过丈夫喝醉的样子。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng méi jiànguò zhàngfu hēzuì de yàngzi.
examples.en: She has never seen her husband drunk.
You can't drive when you're drunk.

examples.pinyin: Tā zuì de zǒu bu dòng lù le.
examples.en: He was so drunk he couldn't walk.

examples.zh: 这瓶酒的味道很让人喜欢，容易喝醉。
examples.pinyin: Zhè píng jiǔ de wèidao hěn ràng rén xǐhuan, róngyì hēzuì.
examples.en: The taste of this bottle of wine is very likable, and it's easy to get drunk on.

examples.zh: 学生们都很尊敬这位老师。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshengmen dōu hěn zūnjìng zhè wèi lǎoshī.
examples.en: The students all greatly respect this teacher.

examples.zh: 他是一位受人尊敬的医生。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì yí wèi shòu rén zūnjìng de yīshēng.
examples.en: He is a doctor who is respected by others.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào zūnjìng měi yí ge rén.

meaning: to comply with; to abide by

examples.zh: 我们应该遵守交通规则。
examples.en: We should abide by traffic rules.

examples.zh: 每个学生都要遵守校规。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge xuésheng dōu yào zūnshǒu xiàoguī.
examples.en: Every student must abide by the school rules.

examples.zh: 他一直遵守自己说过的话。
examples.pinyin: Tā yìzhí zūnshǒu zìjǐ shuōguò de huà.
examples.en: He has always kept his word.

examples.zh: 公司要求员工遵守工作纪律。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī yāoqiú yuángōng zūnshǒu gōngzuò jìlǜ.
examples.en: The company requires employees to abide by work discipline.

examples.zh: 我们要遵守约定的时间。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào zūnshǒu yuēdìng de shíjiān.
examples.en: We should abide by the agreed time.

examples.pinyin: Zhè shì tā zuì zhùmíng de zuòpǐn.
examples.en: This is his most famous work.

examples.zh: 她的作品在展览中展出。
examples.pinyin: Tā de zuòpǐn zài zhǎnlǎn zhōng zhǎnchū.
examples.en: Her work is on display in the exhibition.

examples.zh: 这部作品花了他十年的时间。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù zuòpǐn huā le tā shí nián de shíjiān.
examples.en: This work took him ten years to complete.

examples.zh: 我很喜欢这位作家的作品。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuan zhè wèi zuòjiā de zuòpǐn.
examples.en: I really like this writer's works.

examples.zh: 这幅作品受到了很多人的喜爱。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fú zuòpǐn shòudào le hěn duō rén de xǐ'ài.
examples.en: This work has received love from many people.

examples.zh: 作为一名老师，她非常负责任。
examples.pinyin: Zuòwéi yì míng lǎoshī, tā fēicháng fùzérèn.
examples.en: As a teacher, she is very responsible.

examples.pinyin: Zhè kěyǐ zuòwéi yí ge lìzi.
examples.en: This can serve as an example.

examples.zh: 作为父母，我们要以身作则。
examples.en: As parents, we should lead by example.

examples.zh: 他把这份工作作为自己的事业。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ zhè fèn gōngzuò zuòwéi zìjǐ de shìyè.
examples.en: He treats this job as his own career.

examples.zh: 作为一个学生，学习是他的责任。
examples.pinyin: Zuòwéi yí ge xuésheng, xuéxí shì tā de zérèn.
examples.en: As a student, studying is his responsibility.

meaning: to write an essay; composition (student essay)

examples.zh: 老师让我们写一篇作文。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen xiě yì piān zuòwén.
examples.en: The teacher had us write an essay.

examples.pinyin: Tā de zuòwén xiě de hěn hǎo.
examples.en: Her essay is written very well.

examples.zh: 这次作文的题目是《我的家乡》。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì zuòwén de tímù shì «Wǒ de Jiāxiāng».

examples.zh: 他在作文课上认真练习写作。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài zuòwén kè shàng rènzhēn liànxí xiězuò.
examples.en: He seriously practices writing in composition class.

examples.zh: 她的作文得到了老师的表扬。
examples.pinyin: Tā de zuòwén dédào le lǎoshī de biǎoyáng.
examples.en: Her essay received praise from the teacher.
